'''Jared Jensen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Lindon tournament]] on 10 February 2001 with Dark draft deck (TIEs, All Power To Weapons, Moff Jerjerrod, walker), according to Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1767">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-smeg-eats-lindon-apart-kinda-02-10-01d1767/ smeg-eats-lindon-apart-kinda-02-10-01], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 23 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-smeg-eats-lindon-apart-kinda-02-10-01d1767/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
